name: Beach Vacation Checklist
description: A complete beach vacation checklist covering sun protection, swimwear, beach gear, the day bag and travel essentials.

items.note: Check the expiry date and replace anything older than a year.

items.text: Two swimsuits so one can dry
Sleepwear and underwear for the trip length
Beach umbrella or pop-up sun shade
Cooler or insulated bag for drinks
Beach toys for kids: bucket, shovel, ball
Waterproof phone pouch and a small dry bag
Cash and ID in a waterproof pouch
A book, magazine, or downloaded entertainment
Travel-sized shampoo, conditioner, and body wash
Daily medications and a basic first-aid kit
Motion-sickness remedy if you plan boat trips
Hairbrush and detangler for salt water
Debit or credit card and cash
Check the local weather and tide times before each beach day

faq.q: What should I pack for a beach vacation?
faq.a: Pack swimwear, sun protection like sunscreen and a hat, beach towels, sandals, and a day bag for the shore. Add quick-dry clothing, a refillable water bottle, and any gear such as an umbrella or snorkel set you plan to use.

faq.q: How much sunscreen should I bring?
faq.a: Plan for about an ounce per full-body application and reapply every two hours, so a family can go through a bottle quickly. Bring a broad-spectrum SPF 30 or higher and a water-resistant formula for swimming.

faq.q: What goes in a beach day bag?
faq.a: Keep sunscreen, water, snacks, a towel, sunglasses, a phone in a waterproof pouch, and a light cover-up in your beach bag. Pack a small dry bag for valuables and a plastic bag for wet swimsuits on the way back.

faq.q: Can I print this beach vacation checklist?
faq.a: Yes. You can print the checklist or download it as a PDF, then tick off each item as you pack your suitcase and load your beach bag.

faq.q: How do I keep sand out of my bag?
faq.a: Use a beach bag with a mesh or shake-out bottom, bring baby powder to brush sand off skin easily, and pack a separate bag for sandy or wet items so they stay away from clean clothes.
